steps.en: Add the component package for your framework
steps.zh: 装上你所用框架的组件包

steps.en: Ships one typed component per brand, built from the merged icon registry
steps.zh: 按合并后的图标清单，给每个品牌生成一个带类型的组件

steps.en: Import the brands you need by slug
steps.zh: 按 slug 引入你要的品牌

steps.en: Render it like any SVG element
steps.zh: 像普通 SVG 元素一样渲染

steps.en: Per-icon modules let your bundler drop every icon you did not import
steps.zh: 每个图标一个模块，打包器会丢掉你没引入的全部图标

value.en: Brand logos land in your UI as typed components, without hunting press kits or shipping the whole catalogue
value.zh: 品牌 logo 以带类型的组件进入界面，不用再翻各家媒体资源包，也不会把整个目录打进产物
